title: Retry helper
content: Wrap outbound HTTP requests in exponential backoff with jitter. Cap at five attempts and only retry on 429 and 5xx responses.

title: Postgres index tuning
content: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE first. A composite index on (user_id, created_at) removed the sequential scan on the orders table. Watch out for index bloat after bulk updates.

title: useEffect cleanup
content: Return a cleanup function from useEffect that unsubscribes event listeners on unmount, otherwise React keeps calling setState on a dead component.

title: Docker multi-stage builds
content: Compile in a builder stage and copy only the dist folder into a distroless runtime stage. Our image went from 1.2 GB to 140 MB.

title: Git rebase vs merge
content: Rebase feature branches onto main before opening a pull request to keep history linear. Never rebase commits that teammates have already pulled.

title: JWT refresh flow
content: Access tokens live 15 minutes; the refresh token is an httpOnly cookie rotated on every use. Reuse of an old refresh token revokes the whole session family.

title: Kubernetes probes
content: Liveness probe restarts a hung container; readiness probe removes the pod from the service until warm-up finishes. Give the startup probe a generous failureThreshold.

title: Token bucket rate limiting
content: Each client gets a bucket of 100 tokens refilled at 10 per second. A request spends one token; an empty bucket means HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

title: CSS grid cheatsheet
content: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(16rem, 1fr)) gives responsive cards without media queries. Use gap instead of margins between cells.

title: Python virtual environments
content: python -m venv .venv then pip install -r requirements.txt. Never pip install into the system interpreter; pin versions with pip-tools.

title: Quarterly report Q3
content: Revenue grew 12 percent quarter over quarter. Churn fell to 3 percent after the onboarding redesign. Gross margin held at 71 percent.

title: Hiring plan
content: Open two backend engineer roles in Q3 and one designer in Q4. Interview loop: take-home exercise, system design, team fit.

title: 1:1 with manager
content: Discussed promotion criteria for senior level: owning a project end to end, mentoring juniors, writing design docs. Revisit in six weeks.

title: Team OKRs
content: Objective: make search delightful. Key results: p95 latency under 300 ms, recall at 5 above 0.8, weekly active searchers up 20 percent.

title: Customer interview: Acme
content: The signup wizard confused them: too many fields on step two and no progress indicator. They almost gave up before inviting colleagues.

title: Pricing experiment
content: Offer two months free on annual plans to half of new trials and compare conversion to paid after 30 days.

title: Postmortem: database outage
content: The primary ran out of disk because WAL archiving stalled. Writes failed for 42 minutes. Action items: disk alerts at 80 percent, archive monitoring.

title: Sprint retrospective
content: Too many meetings ate into focus time. We agreed on no-meeting Wednesdays and shorter standups capped at 10 minutes.

title: Attention Is All You Need
content: The Transformer drops recurrence entirely and relies on self-attention. Multi-head attention lets the model attend to different positions in parallel, which trains much faster on GPUs.

title: Spaced repetition
content: Review cards at growing intervals: 1 day, 3 days, a week, a month. The Ebbinghaus curve shows we lose most new information within days without review.

title: Deep Work book notes
content: Cal Newport argues that long blocks of undistracted concentration produce the most valuable output. Schedule them, shut off notifications, embrace boredom.

title: Sleep and memory
content: Slow-wave sleep replays the day's experiences and moves them from the hippocampus into long-term storage in the cortex. Pulling an all-nighter before an exam backfires.

title: Carbon capture
content: Direct air capture pulls CO2 from ambient air using sorbents, then stores it underground. Still costs over 400 dollars per tonne.

title: Roommate bill splitter
content: An app where flatmates scan the supermarket receipt and each taps the items they bought; it settles balances at month end.

title: Article summariser extension
content: Browser extension that turns a long blog post into five bullet points and an estimated reading time.

title: Sourdough starter
content: Feed the starter equal weights of flour and water daily. It is ready to bake with when it doubles within six hours and smells tangy.

title: Kyoto itinerary
content: Day one: Fushimi Inari at sunrise to beat the crowds, then Kiyomizu-dera. Day two: Arashiyama bamboo grove and the monkey park.

title: Personal finance basics
content: Keep six months of expenses as a cash cushion, then put monthly savings into a low-fee global index fund and leave it alone.

title: Half marathon plan
content: Twelve weeks: three easy runs, one tempo session and one long run each week, adding a kilometre to the long run every week. Taper in the final ten days.

title: Box breathing
content: Inhale for four seconds, hold four, exhale four, hold four. Five rounds calms nerves before a presentation.

title: TypeScript generics
content: function first<T>(items: T[]): T | undefined. Constrain with extends keyof to accept only property names of an object.

title: Redis caching strategy
content: Cache-aside: read from Redis, on miss load from the database and set with a TTL. Invalidate the key on write rather than updating it.

title: Accessibility checklist
content: Every image needs alt text, contrast at least 4.5 to 1, all controls reachable with the Tab key, and visible focus outlines.

title: OAuth PKCE for SPAs
content: Single-page apps cannot keep a client secret, so they send a code challenge derived from a random verifier and prove possession when exchanging the authorization code.

title: Load testing with k6
content: Ramp to 500 virtual users over five minutes and assert p95 under 400 ms. Run it against staging every night.

title: Feature flag rollout
content: Ship dark behind a flag, enable for staff, then 5 percent, 25 percent and everyone. Delete the flag within two sprints of full launch.

title: Code review guidelines
content: Keep pull requests under 400 lines, explain the why in the description, and comment on behaviour rather than style that a linter can catch.

title: Handling time zones
content: Store timestamps in UTC and convert to the viewer's zone only when displaying. Daylight saving shifts break naive date arithmetic.

title: Unicode normalization
content: The same accented letter can be one code point or two. Normalize to NFC before comparing strings or using them as keys.

title: 3-2-1 backup rule
content: Three copies of the data, on two different media, one of them offsite. Test restoring at least once a quarter.
